ul.li: Asset file is unpacked into vertices/indices
Indices/vertices are packed into an engine::MeshAsset

core hands this to the renderer backend
Renderer uploads data to GPU.
Renderer saves the address of the vertexes + the buffer of the indices into a RenderObject
Renderer returns an opaque handle to this MeshAsset
Core then on each simulation loop, builds the RenderObjects (MeshAsset + Material) into a DrawContext, ideally made trimmed based on frustum culling
Renderer iterates through DrawContext (multiple RenderObjects), sorting by materials, and runs draw calls on each object

div.p: Note: Material usage is not shown. RenderObjects without a material are acceptable, and will use the default material instead.
This is intentional, as material uploading can happen in parallel to mesh uploading, especially in the future advent of asynchronous and parallelized loading.

g.text: From Disk To Display - Static Mesh
4. Submits DrawContext (built from scene tree) for a frame
5. Draw calls with shaders turn into pixels on screen
